vo: You get paid twice. So why is your money still a mystery?
Salary lands on day one. One million, four hundred and fifty thousand kwacha, in the bank.
Then the broiler sales arrive on day fifteen. Two hundred and eighty thousand, on Airtel Money.
Some in cash, some on Airtel Money, some in the bank.
With Ndalama, you record each income, and how it was paid.
Then the whole month sits in one place.
One million, seven hundred and thirty thousand kwacha comes in each month, salary and broilers together.
And it tells you what is safe to spend today. Four thousand, nine hundred and twelve kwacha, every day, for twenty three days.
Your bills are set aside first, and you get a reminder the day before.
Today at a glance. A budget that fits. Goals that stay on track.
Salary and side income, one calm number.
